value: obj-mercys-incense-box

value: routine ritual induced lightheadedness and metallic taste

value: investigate wailing in the main alley in response to neighbors' reports

value: obj-talisman (left under altar)

value: search locked room in temple basement with witnesses and report any names back to the hall

value: obj-ritual-kit

value: prick behind left eye; throat tightening

value: loc-alley-13

value: photograph of a barefoot boy (black-and-white), folded and stained

value: lightheadedness; metallic tang at back of mouth after rite
quote: When the folded talisman touched the knife-tip and she pressed it to her forehead, Mercy felt the city move under her palms. The old, familiar price followed: a brief lightheadedness and the metallic tang at the back of her mouth.

value: obj-ritual-kit (dented censer, talismans, folded incantation slip, chalk, little knife)
quote: Inside the case the dented censer caught the light like a small bruise; talismans, a folded incantation slip, chalk and the little knife lay where fingers could find them in the dark.

value: numb fingers; pressure at throat; memory disturbance after the rite
quote: The room went cold ... Mercy's fingers went numb where they held the talisman. A pressure wrapped the base of her throat ... she swallowed against the draft and felt something unnamed shift at the edges of her memory.

value: investigate the bombed yard next
quote: Mercy stepped to the threshold and, with the room's half-attentive watch on her, said, quiet and steady, "We go to the yard next."

value: loc-bombed-yard
quote: She walked back through the low gate with the cloth small against her palm and the taste of iron in the air.

value: obj-bloodstained-cloth (carried to shrine with witnesses)
quote: She rose, the cloth carefully folded back among his other things, and said, "We will take it to the shrine. We will have witnesses."

value: lingering ritual effects: chest tightness; memory blank; extended finger numbness; high ringing persisted
quote: As the visitors watched, the yard tasted colder and the wailing lengthened; Mercy felt the cost of the earlier rite reassert itself—her chest tightened, a blank slipped ... and the numbness in her fingers lasted longer than it had that morning.

value: loc-ruined-library
quote: Mercy moved her hands over the central table...

value: talisman in kit; ache at temple from diagnostic test
quote: Mercy folded the talisman into her palm and felt the ache at her temple where the test had tugged the memory loose; the price of inquiry had been paid in a thinning of a detail she wished she'd kept.

value: cross-reference ledgers/newspapers; consult hospital; gather witnesses for naming
quote: Mercy folded the talisman into her palm and said, softly, "We start with the ledgers. We ask the hospital orderly. We gather witnesses."

value: loc-stairwell-meeting
quote: Mercy sat on the worn step, her kit at her knee, and let the room settle into the shape of what had to be decided.

value: white ache at temple; thinning of memory edges from ritual cost
quote: She had already paid for the day's small rites; it showed in a white ache at her temple and a thinning at the edges of memory.

value: monitor the group going to the yard; maintain witness list; report back to Elders
quote: "Watch them," she said to the group that stayed. "If they get reckless, come back. We keep a witness list. We tell the Elders. We do not let this become a hunt."

value: loc-wet-market
quote: She tightened her fingers on the kit's strap and moved, cautious and watched, toward the shrine where witnesses could be gathered and the photograph could be read with care.

value: obj-family-photo (secured in inner pocket of kit)

value: heightened ringing; vision narrowing; taste of iron at throat after handling photograph
quote: She felt the high ringing at the edge of her hearing rise into a thin sharpened wire... She tasted iron at the back of her throat and held the photograph like a small, dangerous offering.

value: loc-rooftop
quote: Mercy set her woven case open on the mat and arranged what she needed without show.

value: sharp prick behind left eye; tightening at base of throat; voice thinner; composure reduced
quote: At the same moment she felt the familiar toll that had come with other tests: a sharp prick behind her left eye and a tightening at the base of her throat. It pulled her composure thin; her voice came out higher and thinner than she intended, as if the ritual had borrowed steadiness from her.

value: proceed with caution; acknowledge spirit more personal claim
quote: She tightened her fingers on the kit's strap and felt, like an ember, the knowledge that the spirit had shifted a degree closer to a personal claim.

value: loc-hospital-ward
quote: Mercy moved between curtained bays where cots had been plucked hastily and men’s blankets lay folded into neat, absent shapes.

value: transcribed ledger fragments; holds transcription in notebook
quote: She took out a small notebook and copied the ledger's visible fragments—a transcription of a smudged line, the stub of a burial slip, a note that a page had been torn. Her hand moved in the practiced slowness of someone preserving paper rather than summoning spirits.

value: taste of iron at back of throat; carrying ledger transcription
quote: Mercy left with the taste of iron at the back of her throat and a narrow transcribed strip of ledger pages between her fingers.

value: loc-alley-13
quote: Mercy walked in with her kit under her arm and the photograph folded in the inner pocket; ... Mercy crouched beside him. The alley smelled of frying oil and stale incense; a child's shoe lay by the drain like an unfinished sentence.

value: obj-family-photo; small sketch in notebook
quote: Mercy folded the photograph back into her palm and slipped it, carefully, into the kit's inner pocket. She tucked the small sketch into the notebook and closed it with a clip.

value: map refugee's placement; meet at ruined stairwell at first light with witnesses
quote: "We map it. We do not name to accuse. We will go to the stairwell and see what traces remain, but only with witnesses and care."

value: obj-anchor-locket and obj-bloodstained-cloth preserved in inner envelopes in kit; map sealed with pebble and witnesses' initials
quote: She lifted a square of clean cloth from her kit and laid the locket on it, then folded the cloth over like a small shroud and placed it in an inner envelope of her case. ... she wrapped the locket and cloth again and placed them in separate inner envelopes in her kit; she photographed nothing but clipped a final note and sealed the map with a pebble and two witnesses' initials.

value: experiences ritual cost: prick behind left eye; tightening at base of throat; ringing increased
quote: Mercy felt the pressure like a palm across her sternum and, at the same instant, the familiar sting behind her left eye and the tightening at the base of her throat—her rite's toll. She pressed a thumb there as if to hold herself together.

value: take items to library and ask Elder to examine them with witnesses at first light; make site hold memory via marks and witnesses
quote: "We finish here, then I will take these to the library at first light. We ask the Elder to look with witnesses. For now, we make this place speak with marks and witnesses."

value: loc-kowloon-walled-city (Alley 13)
quote: They left the alley with the east step marked by a pebble and Mercy's map clipped; the city's overlays thinned, leaving ordinary sounds of cooking and footsteps.

value: obj-family-photo secured; used as spatial anchor; talisman placed closed against pebble
quote: She placed a pebble at the center as a marker, then reached into her kit and, with the practiced economy of her rites, pinched a folded talisman and laid it against the pebble as a boundary—kept closed, not opened. She set the photograph flat beside the pebble as a small compass.

value: heightened ringing; throat tightening; steadied with thumb behind eye
quote: Mercy felt the thin wire of ringing in her ears climb a notch. Her throat tightened at the memory's edge and she steadied herself on a breath, pressing a thumb back to the place behind one eye as if to hold the film from tearing.

value: obj-family-photo; short notebook phrase recorded; map clipped
quote: She set the photograph flat beside the pebble as a small compass. Mercy wrote the short phrase into her notebook—brief, for cross-reference later—and initialled it.

value: obj-family-photo held during scroll reading and rite
quote: Mercy held the family photograph like a small compass against the tile and watched the way the Elder's reading made the yard shift.

value: implement witnessed naming ritual with offerings and careful accounting; plan next event at first light
quote: "We will offer a different thing," she said. "We will name what we can with witnesses... We will hold names with offerings so the dead have witnesses, and the living are held for what follows."
